objective: Convert verified Matrix Reprogrammed memberships into a real PayPal subscription system while preserving fail-closed entitlement, webhook authenticity, idempotency and complete billing-state history.
exitCondition: Supporter, Intelligence and Research Pro subscriptions must pass plan bootstrap, checkout, approval, activation, renewal, failed payment, recovery, suspension, cancellation, expiry, refund, reversal, duplicate webhook, reconciliation and production-switch tests before live checkout can be enabled.
principles: PayPal is the payment processor; D1 is the authoritative local membership and entitlement ledger.
Checkout approval is not paid access. Access begins only after PayPal reports an ACTIVE subscription or a verified completed subscription payment consistent with the plan.
Webhook events are processed only after signature verification and event-id deduplication.
The raw webhook event must be preserved before parsing and included unchanged in PayPal postback verification.
Each state transition is recorded append-only before the current subscription row is updated.
A first failed payment records past-due state but does not silently invent a cancellation. Suspension, expiry, reversal or refund hold removes paid entitlement.
Cancellation retains access only through a verified paid current_period_end; otherwise access is removed immediately.
Refund and reversal events create a billing hold until reconciliation proves another paid period.
Monthly membership never grants separate-product access.
Live checkout requires independent environment and D1 activation switches. Either switch being off must block live checkout.
Webhooks and reconciliation continue to operate when new checkout is disabled so existing billing state remains accurate.
